# Amrita Labs

> Amrita Labs builds Chrome extensions and Shopify apps for creators and merchants. Free tools that score, optimize, and improve your workflow — directly inside the platforms you already use.

## Chrome Extensions

- [EmailSubjectScore Pro](https://amrita-labs.com/gmail-subject-score/): Free Chrome extension that scores Gmail subject lines for spam risk, clarity, and urgency in real time. AI-powered rewrite suggestions. 50 free scores/month.
- [Pinello](https://amrita-labs.com/pinello/): Free Chrome extension that scores Pinterest pins across 5 dimensions — image, board fit, title, description, and hashtags — in real time. AI rewrite included.
- [Privacy Blur for Slack](https://amrita-labs.com/privacy-blur-slack/): Free Chrome extension that blurs sensitive Slack content (messages, channel names, avatars, files) during screen sharing so you can present without leaking private conversations.
- [Privacy Blur for Discord](https://amrita-labs.com/privacy-blur-discord/): Free Chrome extension that blurs sensitive Discord content (server list, channels, DMs, avatars) during screen sharing. Not yet published on Chrome Web Store.
- [Privacy Blur for Microsoft Teams](https://amrita-labs.com/privacy-blur-teams/): Free Chrome extension that blurs sensitive Microsoft Teams content (chats, channels, calendar, notifications) during screen sharing. Not yet published on Chrome Web Store.
- [Privacy Blur for WhatsApp Web](https://amrita-labs.com/privacy-blur-whatsapp/): Free Chrome extension that blurs sensitive WhatsApp Web content (chat list, previews, avatars, media) during screen sharing. Not yet published on Chrome Web Store.

## Shopify Apps

- [Amrita Cookie Consent](https://amrita-labs.com/cookie-consent/): GDPR/CCPA cookie consent banner for Shopify stores. Includes Google Consent Mode v2, 7-language storefront banner, and no third-party scripts.
- [Amrita Chat Widget](https://amrita-labs.com/chat-widget/): Multi-channel chat widget for Shopify — one floating button that opens 9 channels (WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, LINE, Viber, Telegram, SMS, Email, phone). Free forever, no visitor cap, zero cookies, Shadow DOM isolated, 8-language admin.
- [Amrita Accessibility Widget](https://amrita-labs.com/accessibility-widget/): Accessibility toolbar for Shopify stores that helps merchants work toward WCAG 2.1 compatibility — contrast, text resize, dyslexia-friendly font, link highlight, and more. 7-language admin.

## Install Links

- [EmailSubjectScore Pro on Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/emailsubjectscore-pro-sub/dleffnbdjohkmmkbojehdpkgkmpofmgm): Score email subject lines as you type in Gmail.
- [Pinello on Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pinello/kmelegdnljikegoemigfgnpcbllmkije): Score Pinterest pins as you create them.
- [Privacy Blur for Slack on Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/privacy-blur-for-slack/cejmffebfhdnhbjkhiobaecdohheimkj): Blur Slack messages before screen sharing.
- [Amrita Cookie Consent on Shopify App Store](https://apps.shopify.com/cookie-consent-8): Install Amrita Cookie Consent from the Shopify App Store.

## Comparisons

- [Automizy Subject Line Tester Is Gone — Here's What to Use Instead](https://amrita-labs.com/gmail-subject-score/vs/vs-automizy/): Automizy's free subject line tester is dead (404). Looking for an alternative? EmailSubjectScore Pro is free and scores inside Gmail as you type.
- [EmailSubjectScore Pro vs CoSchedule Subject Line Tester](https://amrita-labs.com/gmail-subject-score/vs/vs-coschedule/): Free Chrome extension that scores Gmail subject lines live — vs CoSchedule's free web-based tester. Which workflow is better for you?
- [EmailSubjectScore Pro vs Sendcheckit](https://amrita-labs.com/gmail-subject-score/vs/vs-sendcheckit/): Free Chrome extension that scores Gmail subject lines live as you type — vs Sendcheckit, the free web-based tool. Side-by-side comparison.
- [TouchStone Subject Line Analyzer Is Gone — Here's What to Use](https://amrita-labs.com/gmail-subject-score/vs/vs-touchstone/): ContactMonkey's TouchStone subject line analyzer is dead. Looking for a replacement? EmailSubjectScore Pro is free and works inside Gmail.
- [EmailSubjectScore Pro vs Zurb TestSubject](https://amrita-labs.com/gmail-subject-score/vs/vs-zurb-testsubject/): Free Chrome extension that scores Gmail subject lines live — vs Zurb TestSubject, the classic mobile preview tool. They solve different problems.
